name: 0g-wallet
query:
WITH wallet_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        buyer,
        SUM(nodes_purchased) AS purchased_amt,
        SUM(CASE WHEN use_code = 'yes' THEN nodes_purchased ELSE 0 END) AS with_promo,
        SUM(CASE WHEN use_code = 'no' THEN nodes_purchased ELSE 0 END) AS without_promo,
        SUM(CASE WHEN round = 'WL' THEN nodes_purchased ELSE 0 END) AS wl_amt,
        SUM(CASE WHEN round = 'Public' THEN nodes_purchased ELSE 0 END) AS public_amt,
        SUM(USD_amount) AS USD_amount,
        AVG(USD_amount / nodes_purchased) AS avgUSD_amount
    FROM query_4271957
    WHERE tierID != ''  -- Ensure tierID is not empty
    GROUP BY buyer
)
SELECT 
    buyer,
    purchased_amt,
    with_promo,
    without_promo,
    wl_amt,
    public_amt,
    USD_amount,
    avgUSD_amount
FROM wallet_sales
ORDER BY purchased_amt DESC;

name: 0g-summary
query:
WITH tt_coinlist (sold, node_buyer, node_amount) AS (
    VALUES
        (2052590.25, 1747, 9927)
),
tt_presale_investors (sold, node_buyer, node_amount) AS (
    VALUES
        (2600000, 2657, 8554)
),
main_summary AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(transaction_hash) AS tx_count,
        SUM(nodes_purchased) AS node_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'USDC' THEN total_price END) AS USDC_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'wETH' THEN total_price END) AS WETH_amount,
        
        -- Calculate total USD amount
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN currency = 'USDC' THEN total_price
                WHEN currency = 'wETH' THEN total_price * 3130
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS total_usd_amount,
        
        -- Calculate total WL and Public node counts
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN round = 'WL' THEN nodes_purchased END), 0) AS wl_node_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN round = 'Public' THEN nodes_purchased END), 0) AS public_node_count,
        
        -- Calculate total WL amount
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN round = 'WL' AND currency = 'USDC' THEN total_price
                WHEN round = 'WL' AND currency = 'wETH' THEN total_price * 3130
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS total_wl_amount,

        -- Calculate total Public amount
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN round = 'Public' AND currency = 'USDC' THEN total_price
                WHEN round = 'Public' AND currency = 'wETH' THEN total_price * 3130
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS total_public_amount,
        
        COUNT(DISTINCT buyer) AS unique_buyer
    FROM query_4271957
)
SELECT
    -- Existing columns
    tx_count,
    node_count 
      + tt.node_amount 
      + pre.node_amount AS total_node_count,
    175500 - (node_count + tt.node_amount + pre.node_amount) AS node_reserved,

    USDC_amount,
    WETH_amount,
    total_usd_amount 
      + tt.sold 
      + pre.sold AS total_usd_amount,

    wl_node_count,
    public_node_count,
    total_wl_amount,
    total_public_amount,

    unique_buyer 
      + tt.node_buyer
      + pre.node_buyer AS unique_buyer,

    -- Coinlist columns
    tt.node_amount AS coinlist_node_amount,
    tt.sold        AS coinlist_sold,
    tt.node_buyer  AS coinlist_node_buyer,

    -- Pre-sale columns
    pre.node_amount AS presale_node_amount,
    pre.sold        AS presale_sold,
    pre.node_buyer  AS presale_node_buyer

FROM main_summary
CROSS JOIN tt_coinlist tt
CROSS JOIN tt_presale_investors pre;

name: 0g-tierID-WL
query:
WITH whitelist_sales AS (
    SELECT
        tier,
        tierID,
        SUM(nodes_purchased) AS purchased_amt,  -- Total nodes purchased
        SUM(CASE WHEN use_code = 'yes' THEN nodes_purchased ELSE 0 END) AS with_promo,  -- Nodes purchased with promo code
        SUM(CASE WHEN use_code = 'no' THEN nodes_purchased ELSE 0 END) AS without_promo,  -- Nodes purchased without promo code
        SUM(USD_amount) AS USD_amount,  -- Total ETH spent
        AVG(USD_amount / nodes_purchased) AS Avg_USD_amount  -- Average ETH spent per node
    FROM query_4271957
    WHERE round = 'WL'  -- Filter for Whitelist round
    GROUP BY tier, tierID  -- Group by both tier and tierID
)
SELECT
    tier,
    tierID,
    purchased_amt,
    with_promo,
    without_promo,
    USD_amount,
    Avg_USD_amount
FROM whitelist_sales
ORDER BY tier ASC;

name: 0g-tiers
query:
WITH tier_sales AS (
    SELECT
        t.tier,        
        COALESCE(SUM(t.nodes_purchased), 0) AS sold,  -- Total nodes sold
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.round = 'WL' THEN t.nodes_purchased ELSE 0 END), 0) AS wl_sold,  -- Nodes sold in WL round
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.round = 'Public' THEN t.nodes_purchased ELSE 0 END), 0) AS public_sold,  -- Nodes sold in Public round
        COALESCE(SUM(t.USD_amount), 0) AS USD_amount,  -- Total USD spent for the sales
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.round = 'WL' THEN t.USD_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS wl_USD_amount,  -- USD amount for WL sales
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.round = 'Public' THEN t.USD_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS public_USD_amount  -- USD amount for Public sales
    FROM query_4271957 AS t
    WHERE t.tier IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY t.tier
)
SELECT
    ts.tier,
    tp.tot_cnt AS max_nodes,           -- Maximum number of nodes per tier
    ts.sold,                            -- Total nodes sold
    -- Safe subtraction logic for nodes_left
    CASE
        WHEN ts.sold > tp.tot_cnt THEN 0  -- Set to 0 if sold exceeds max_nodes
        ELSE tp.tot_cnt - ts.sold         -- Otherwise, calculate normally
    END AS nodes_left,
    tp.wl_cnt AS max_wl, 
    ts.wl_sold,
    -- Adjust WL sold percentage to show 100% when oversold
    CASE
        WHEN ts.wl_sold >= tp.wl_cnt THEN 1.0  -- Show 100% if WL sold >= max WL
        ELSE ts.wl_sold * 1.0 / NULLIF(tp.wl_cnt, 0)  -- Otherwise, calculate percentage
    END AS wl_sold_pct,  -- Percentage of WL nodes sold
    tp.public_cnt AS max_public,  
    ts.public_sold,
    COALESCE(ts.public_sold * 1.0 / NULLIF(tp.public_cnt, 0), 0) AS public_sold_pct,  -- Percentage of Public nodes sold
    CASE
        WHEN ts.sold >= tp.tot_cnt THEN 1.0  -- 100% if sold exceeds or equals max_nodes
        ELSE ts.sold * 1.0 / NULLIF(tp.tot_cnt, 0)  -- Otherwise, calculate percentage
    END AS sold_pct,                       -- Percentage of nodes sold
    ts.wl_USD_amount,                  
    ts.public_USD_amount, 
    ts.USD_amount               
FROM tier_sales AS ts
JOIN query_4272050 AS tp ON ts.tier = tp.tier  -- Join with the tier data to get max counts
ORDER BY ts.tier ASC;

name: 0g-stacked-tiers
query:
WITH hours AS (
    SELECT
        sale_hour
    FROM UNNEST(
        sequence(
            TIMESTAMP '2024-11-11 11:00:00',
            CAST(NOW() AS timestamp),
            INTERVAL '1' HOUR
        )
    ) AS t(sale_hour)
),
tiers AS (
    SELECT tier
    FROM UNNEST(
        SEQUENCE(1, 36)
    ) AS t(tier)
),
hourly_tiers AS (
    SELECT
        h.sale_hour,
        t.tier
    FROM hours h
    CROSS JOIN tiers t
),
sales_per_hour_tier AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('hour', t.block_time) AS sale_hour,
        t.tier,
        SUM(t.nodes_purchased) AS nodes_sold
    FROM query_4271957 AS t
    WHERE
        t.tier BETWEEN 1 AND 36
        AND t.block_time >= TIMESTAMP '2024-11-11 11:00:00'
    GROUP BY
        DATE_TRUNC('hour', t.block_time),
        t.tier
),
hourly_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ht.sale_hour,
        ht.tier,
        COALESCE(s.nodes_sold, 0) AS nodes_sold
    FROM hourly_tiers ht
    LEFT JOIN sales_per_hour_tier s
        ON ht.sale_hour = s.sale_hour AND ht.tier = s.tier
),
cumulative_sales AS (
    SELECT
        sale_hour,
        tier,
        nodes_sold,
        SUM(nodes_sold) OVER (
            PARTITION BY tier
            ORDER BY sale_hour ASC
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS cumulative_nodes_sold_by_tier
    FROM hourly_sales
)
SELECT
    sale_hour,
    tier,
    nodes_sold,
    cumulative_nodes_sold_by_tier
FROM cumulative_sales
ORDER BY
    sale_hour ASC,
    tier ASC;

name: 0g-promocode
query:

    SELECT 
        with_code AS promo_code,
        SUM(nodes_purchased) AS purchased_amt,
        SUM(CASE WHEN round = 'WL' THEN nodes_purchased ELSE 0 END) AS wl_amt,
        SUM(CASE WHEN round = 'Public' THEN nodes_purchased ELSE 0 END) AS public_amt,
        SUM(USD_amount) AS USD_amount,
        AVG(USD_amount / nodes_purchased) AS avgUSD_amount
    FROM query_4271957

)

    purchased_amt,

name: 0g-hourlysales
query:
WITH hourly_sales AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('hour', t.block_time) AS sale_hour,
        SUM(t.nodes_purchased) AS nodes_sold,
        SUM(t.USD_amount) AS amount_credited
    FROM query_4271957 AS t
    WHERE t.tier IS NOT NULL AND t.tier != 0  -- Exclude tier 0 if needed
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('hour', t.block_time)
)
SELECT
    sale_hour,
    nodes_sold,
    amount_credited,
    -- Cumulative sum of nodes sold by hour
    SUM(nodes_sold) OVER (ORDER BY sale_hour ASC) AS cumulative_nodes_sold_by_hour,
    -- Cumulative amount credited by hour
    SUM(amount_credited) OVER (ORDER BY sale_hour ASC) AS cumulative_amount_credited
FROM hourly_sales
ORDER BY sale_hour ASC;

    FROM query_4271957
    WHERE round = 'Public'  -- Filter for Whitelist round
